'''Nghia Nguyen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished Top 6 at [[2000 Mountain View Grand Slam]] on 19 February 2000, according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d283">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-26-mt-view-california-2-19d283/ mt-view-california-2-19], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 26 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-26-mt-view-california-2-19d283/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
